1.consolidated_definition: . Caso, hecho, lo cierto, etc., para reproducir o explicar una circunstancia antes enunciada. “Juan dice que está enfermo, pero el negocio es que no quiere venir.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: Circumstance or fact used to reproduce or explain a previously stated situation. "Juan says he is ill, but the point is that he does not want to come."
